findings.claim: The glance never answers the story's question. status for exec-m08-judge7 returns attention="unknown" at sequence 13 and still "unknown" 103s later at sequence 14. There is no yes/no sleep verdict anywhere in the payload, so the operator's one-glance decision is undecidable by construction.
findings.remediation: Make attention a total function over states: emit "ok" | "needs_operator" | "unknown_because_X" and require that "unknown" carries a bounded expiry after which it degrades to "needs_operator". Never let the only headline field be the absence of an answer.

findings.claim: A real failure is invisible in the summary. Event sequence 11 records flaky_check outcome=retryable_failure reason=tool_exited_non_zero, yet status shows failed:0, untriagedInterruptions:[], and no attentionReason mentioning flaky_check. Only a full event-tail read (50 events, ~15k tokens) surfaces it. An operator who glances goes back to sleep on a run that already broke.
findings.remediation: Surface retry/failure state in the summary: add a retrying/degraded bucket to nodeStateCounts, and add an attentionReason for any node with a recorded non-success outcome since last triage, even when the runtime intends to retry.

findings.claim: Silence detection is disabled for exactly the node that is stuck. judge has been state=running with no event for 103 observed silence seconds, and the sole reason attention is unknown is that judge has no_declared_budget. The one signal that would say "hung, wake up" is switched off precisely where it is needed.
findings.remediation: Apply a default silence budget (per-profile or execution-wide fallback) when a node declares none, and report silence against that default rather than refusing to evaluate. Treat missing budget as a config warning, not as a reason to suppress the health verdict.

findings.claim: The prescribed remedy is not reachable from the operator's surface. Every attentionReason points to remedy="declareNodeBudget", but the exposed MCP tools (status, events, probe, routes, start, signal, approve, pause, resume, cancel, wake_arm, wake_status, wake_wait) contain no budget-declaring operation. The monitor tells the operator to do something the monitor cannot do.
findings.remediation: Either expose a declareNodeBudget mutation on the same surface, or emit remedies as executable references (tool name + arguments) and validate at build time that every remedy string maps to a callable tool.

findings.claim: Retry state carries no schedule. flaky_check sits in queued after a retryable_failure with no attempt count, no backoff, and no next-attempt timestamp in status or in the event payload. The operator cannot distinguish "will retry in 5s" from "wedged forever", which is the exact discrimination the sleep decision needs.
findings.remediation: Include attempt number, max attempts, and nextAttemptAt on retryable_failure events and mirror them in status per node.

findings.claim: The wake path gave no usable signal for the sleep loop. wake_arm at cursor 13 followed by wake_wait returned outcome=timeout after 60s while the run was silently stalled, so the block expired with the operator no better informed and no distinction between "quiet because healthy" and "quiet because stuck".
findings.remediation: Let the lease ring on derived attention transitions (e.g. silence budget exceeded, node entered retry) in addition to log appends, so a stall wakes the operator instead of expiring the wait.

findings.claim: Arming a lease perturbs the progress counter the operator reasons with: wake_arm returned headSequence 14 while contentHead stayed 13, so a read-only monitoring action advances the sequence an operator uses as a proxy for "did anything happen".
findings.remediation: Keep lease bookkeeping off the content stream, or have status report contentHead alongside headSequence so a bumped sequence is not mistaken for progress.

findings.claim: The status payload is not glanceable: ~20 top-level fields, no one-line verdict, and attentionReasons duplicates silenceUnevaluated verbatim, forcing the operator to parse redundant nested structures at 3am.
findings.remediation: Add a single headline field (verdict + short human sentence) at the top of the payload, and drop one of the two identical reason arrays.
